name: MultiSector
author: bluenerd8
description: Experimental multiplayer for Starsector. Share the host's world, see each other's fleets, and stay on one shared date with shared pause. Use the MultiSector launcher to host or join; F8 in the campaign shows the players. Where players are together (star systems and hyperspace), NPC fleets are shared and can be fought; wreckage and objectives are shared everywhere. Markets are shared through the host. Click another player's fleet to talk and trade; join each other's battles with your own ships.
